mechanism: Tamoxifen may increase risk of osteonecrosis of the jaw (ONJ) when combined with zoledronic acid due to additive effects on bone metabolism and increased bone turnover suppression.
action: Monitor for signs of ONJ including jaw pain, swelling, or delayed healing; ensure dental evaluation before initiating zoledronic acid and maintain proper oral hygiene; consider alternative bisphosphonate if ONJ risk is high.
